ENFJ>INTJ.title: You quietly map out a detailed future with people at its heart.
ENFJ>INTJ.body: Imagining what could be and planning a clear path toward it — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have the energy you get from being with people and the depth you find alone, the kindness to sense how others feel and the calm to decide by logic. You can build a plan for everyone alone in a quiet room, then present it with more passion than anyone.
ENFJ>INTJ.say: "I've already mapped out the whole flow. …Just tell me if everyone can keep up without strain."
ENFJ>INTJ.do: You work late into the night on the team's long-term plan, then share it the next morning with a personal note for each member.
ENFJ>INTJ.worry: The more efficient the idea, the more you worry it leaves someone's feelings behind, and you can't commit. Some days you want to see everyone, some days no one, and the swing throws even you off.
ENFJ>INTJ.karai: Your five-year plan is flawless. Your plans for this weekend? Still blank.

ENFJ>INTP.title: You have the warmth to lift people up and a mind that thinks things all the way through.
ENFJ>INTP.body: Trusting your hunches and seeing possibilities — that's the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have almost every pair: energy from people and from deep solo thinking, a heart that values feelings and a mind that follows logic, the skill to plan ahead and the ease to go with the flow. When someone comes to you for advice, you cheer them up — and before you know it, you've taken the whole problem apart to see how it works.
ENFJ>INTP.say: "That sounds really hard. …By the way, mind if I sketch out how it got this way?"
ENFJ>INTP.do: On the way home after hearing a friend's troubles, you come up with three possible fixes and quietly message them the next day.
ENFJ>INTP.worry: Wanting to help others and wanting to chase your own interests pull equally hard, so you're torn over how to spend your time. You can't move until your thoughts settle, yet you keep picturing the faces of the people waiting on you.
ENFJ>INTP.karai: Encouraging words for others come out in a second. Your own replies? Left to sit for three days.

ENFJ>ENTJ.title: You lead people's passion with clear, steady decisions.
ENFJ>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people, picturing what's ahead, and planning your way forward — those are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can sense each person's feelings and also make clean, logical calls. You set the goal and pull everyone along, yet you stop to check on anyone falling behind. You're a leader people rely on, with warmth always mixed into your firmness.
ENFJ>ENTJ.say: "The deadline is Friday — that part's not moving. …But if anyone's struggling, tell me now."
ENFJ>ENTJ.do: After wrapping up a meeting with a crisp decision, you send a private thank-you only to the person who seemed down.
ENFJ>ENTJ.worry: Even after making the right call, you lie awake wondering if someone got hurt. When you need to be tough, one look at their face and you soften your words.
ENFJ>ENTJ.karai: You boosted everyone's morale — but the math on your own exhaustion doesn't add up.

ENFJ>ENTP.title: You have a caring heart and a sharp mind that cuts in with fresh ideas.
ENFJ>ENTP.body: Coming alive around people and looking toward new possibilities — that's the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both a heart that values feelings and a mind that tests the logic, and both a knack for careful planning and the freedom to act on a whim. While you get a discussion buzzing, you slip in an idea no one else thought of — and shape it so everyone can get on board.
ENFJ>ENTP.say: "Wouldn't it be fun to flip that idea around? …Oh, in a way where nobody loses out, of course."
ENFJ>ENTP.do: A casual chat sparks a new project, and you've split up the roles before the conversation ends.
ENFJ>ENTP.worry: You want to push your idea forward, but you also understand why others object, and that puts on the brakes. The moment you make a plan, a more interesting way pops up and you can't settle.
ENFJ>ENTP.karai: The one who got the debate going is the first to wander off on a tangent.

ENFJ>INFJ.title: You put your care for people to work in lively rooms and quiet ones alike.
ENFJ>INFJ.body: Picturing possibilities, valuing people's feelings, and planning your way forward — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the ability to settle your heart alone. In front of a crowd you lift everyone up, and one-on-one you listen closely, putting into words feelings the other person hadn't even noticed yet.
ENFJ>INFJ.say: "Let's all talk it through! …Oh, but first, can I hear just what you think?"
ENFJ>INFJ.do: After hosting an event with a big smile, you ride the train home alone, replaying what people said to you that day.
ENFJ>INFJ.worry: The days you help the most are the days you come home completely drained. You take in someone's worries so deeply that your own heart grows heavy too.
ENFJ>INFJ.karai: You can read every tiny shift in other people's hearts, yet you miss your own battery level.

ENFJ>INFP.title: You have a warmth that lights up others and a heart that tends its own feelings with care.
ENFJ>INFP.body: Trusting your intuition and putting feelings first — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the depth you find alone, and both the skill to plan ahead and the ease to follow your mood and the flow. When you act for someone else, you're amazingly driven; when it's about you, you can wait patiently until your heart says, "This is it."
ENFJ>INFP.say: "I think that's wonderful! …I'm going to check in with my own feelings for a bit, too."
ENFJ>INFP.do: You cheer on a friend's dream and even help plan it, while your own dream stays tucked safely in your journal.
ENFJ>INFP.worry: Living up to others' hopes and staying true to your own heart both matter, and when you can't choose, you freeze. Even with a plan, on days your heart isn't in it you can't start — and then you blame yourself.
ENFJ>INFP.karai: You push everyone else forward with all your strength, but your own back? "Still getting ready."

ENFJ>ENFJ.title: You've grown your gift for bringing out the best in people, straight and true.
ENFJ>ENFJ.body: The temperament you were born with and the character you've grown through experience are the same type. Your belief in people's potential, your way of standing by their feelings, and your knack for getting everyone facing the same direction have grown steadily without wavering. Because your sense of self is so clear, you shine where you can help — and where you can't see how people respond, you tend to lose energy without knowing why.
ENFJ>ENFJ.say: "It's okay, you can do this. Let's do it together!"
ENFJ>ENFJ.do: At a gathering full of strangers, you end up introducing everyone to each other, and by the time you leave, you've started a group chat.
ENFJ>ENFJ.worry: When people count on you, you take on everything, and your time for yourself quietly disappears. If the mood around you clouds over even a little, you wonder if it's your fault.
ENFJ>ENFJ.karai: You wish so hard for everyone's happiness that you forget to save a slice for yourself.

ENFJ>ENFP.title: You can turn your passion for people into solid plans — or let it spread out freely.
ENFJ>ENFP.body: Getting energy from people, trusting your intuition, and deciding with your heart — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the skill to plan your way forward and the flexibility to adjust as things change. You plan something fun, invite everyone, and laugh your way through the surprises on the day, so the world of the people around you naturally grows bigger.
ENFJ>ENFP.say: "I've pulled together everyone's schedules for next month! …Oh, but what if we suddenly feel like going to the beach that day?"
ENFJ>ENFP.do: You carefully build a trip itinerary — then deliberately write in, "Open time: decide on the spot."
ENFJ>ENFP.worry: Wanting people to have fun, you pack the schedule full, and suddenly there's no free time left for you. The gap between days you want everything in order and days you don't want to decide anything leaves even you confused.
ENFJ>ENFP.karai: On the "let's just wing it" trip, guess who did the most research? You.

ENFJ>ISTJ.title: You turn your warmth for people into steady support, one reliable step at a time.
ENFJ>ISTJ.body: Planning ahead and seeing things through — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the focus you find alone, both an eye for future possibilities and a solid habit of building on facts, and both the kindness to read feelings and the fairness to decide by logic. People often see you as "the precise one," but that precision is always about making sure no one gets stuck.
ENFJ>ISTJ.say: "Please follow these steps as written. …Oh, and I'll check in with the new person myself."
ENFJ>ISTJ.do: You finish a flawless handover document, then add handwritten notes only where the reader might trip up.
ENFJ>ISTJ.worry: Wanting people to follow the rules clashes with not wanting to blame them, so you rewrite your reminder over and over. You want to see people, but if you're not fully prepared, you're tired before you even meet.
ENFJ>ISTJ.karai: You're trying to add "being considerate" to the manual, too.

ENFJ>ISFJ.title: You share your caring nature with both bright cheer and careful attention.
ENFJ>ISFJ.body: Valuing people's feelings and planning your way forward — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the calm you find alone, and both a feel for future possibilities and a careful habit of checking the facts in front of you. In front of everyone you're the bright cheerleader, and behind the scenes you remember each person's tastes and even how they're feeling — your thoughtfulness reaches everywhere.
ENFJ>ISFJ.say: "Let's all do our best! …Also, Sam was coughing a bit yesterday, so I brought some throat drops."
ENFJ>ISFJ.do: You take on planning a farewell party and pick the restaurant by recalling the guest of honor's favorite foods from years of conversations.
ENFJ>ISFJ.worry: Helping others never feels like a burden, but somehow your own plans always end up last. Some days you want to talk about big dreams, yet you stop yourself with "I need to be realistic."
ENFJ>ISFJ.karai: Everyone's special days are in your planner. Your own birthday? You remember it when someone tells you.

ENFJ>ESTJ.title: You move things steadily forward with energy that lifts people up.
ENFJ>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people and planning your way forward — that's the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both the imagination to picture what's ahead and the drive to act on facts, and both the kindness to stand by people's feelings and the fairness to decide by logic. You set clear goals and steps to get everyone moving, and you truly notice who worked hard and say so — so even though you're strict, people are glad to follow you.
ENFJ>ESTJ.say: "We're hitting this number by the end of the month, no matter what. …And last week's slides were really clear — thank you."
ENFJ>ESTJ.do: You update the progress chart every morning, adding a word of praise whenever you spot a team member's small win.
ENFJ>ESTJ.worry: Every time someone breaks the rules, you wear yourself down deciding whether to call it out or put their feelings first. The more you push forward with reality, the more it feels like you're drifting from the dreams you once had.
ENFJ>ESTJ.karai: You manage the team's schedule to the minute, but your own break is "if there's time."

ENFJ>ESFJ.title: You can turn your care for people toward the future and toward everyday life alike.
ENFJ>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people, valuing feelings, and planning your way forward — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both a feel for possibilities no one can see yet and a steady respect for past experience and facts. You dream up everyone's future together while also minding today's snacks and seating, so at any gathering you're the center of that sense of ease.
ENFJ>ESFJ.say: "Let's do something even bigger next year! …For now — did everyone actually eat lunch?"
ENFJ>ESFJ.do: You volunteer for the local festival, pitching new ideas while carefully passing on last year's tricks that worked.
ENFJ>ESFJ.worry: You want everyone to be happy so much that one unhappy face keeps your heart from resting. You feel pulled between wanting to try new things and wanting to protect the ways that work.
ENFJ>ESFJ.karai: By the time you've handed out plates to everyone, your own food has gone cold.

ENFJ>ISTP.title: You pair cool, capable skill with a real warmth for people.
ENFJ>ISTP.body: You're a calm, hands-on type who doesn't say much and quickly solves the problem in front of you. You also carry a deep warmth that wants people to grow and wants to cheer them on. So even as a person of few words, you can't leave someone struggling alone. You have both the kindness to help quietly and the fire for a heartfelt word when it really counts.
ENFJ>ISTP.say: "It's no big deal. …But I think you can do even more."
ENFJ>ISTP.do: You quietly fix a junior's mistake without a word, and later just say, "You were on the right track."
ENFJ>ISTP.worry: You really want to encourage people, but putting it into words feels awkward, so you let actions do the talking. Sometimes you do so much for others that your own time runs out.
ENFJ>ISTP.karai: You act all cool, but you're secretly keeping a diary of your junior's growth.

ENFJ>ISFP.title: You can show your kindness through words and through your own sense of beauty.
ENFJ>ISFP.body: Deciding with care for people's feelings — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the fullness you find in time alone, both a feel for future possibilities and a sense that savors the beauty right in front of you, and both the skill to plan and the softness to go with your mood. Encouraging words for everyone, a small handmade gift slipped in quietly — you offer both naturally.
ENFJ>ISFP.say: "Everyone's feelings came through, I promise. …Oh, doesn't this flower's color look like today's sky?"
ENFJ>ISFP.do: You organize a group card for a friend's birthday and quietly tuck in a little something you picked out on your own.
ENFJ>ISFP.worry: The more you plan to meet others' expectations, the more your heart lags behind. You love lively gatherings, but afterward you need quiet time alone to recharge.
ENFJ>ISFP.karai: You're the first to notice how others feel, and the last to notice you're tired.

ENFJ>ESTP.title: You bring the energy that fires people up and the drive to jump into action on the spot.
ENFJ>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the power to picture possibilities and the grip to handle what's real right now, both the kindness to read feelings and the clarity to make clean, logical calls, and both the skill to plan ahead and the push to move on momentum. After you've talked about everyone's dreams and got them excited, you're the first to dive in and clear the way.
ENFJ>ESTP.say: "This is going to help everyone, I'm sure of it! …Okay, I'm calling them before I overthink it."
ENFJ>ESTP.do: The moment after hearing a friend's problem, you're already contacting someone you know who could fix it.
ENFJ>ESTP.worry: After deciding on impulse, you look back wondering whether you left anyone behind. Wanting to plan carefully and wanting to move right now fight it out, and you end up thinking on the run.
ENFJ>ESTP.karai: Nobody thinks harder about people's feelings than you — you just move so fast nobody can keep up.

ENFJ>ESFP.title: You warm people with your care and spread it through the fun of the moment.
ENFJ>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with care for feelings — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the power to picture what's ahead and the knack for savoring this very moment, and both the skill to plan and the ability to roll with things and enjoy them. You truly cheer on everyone's future while making the present ridiculously fun, so the people around you can't help smiling.
ENFJ>ESFP.say: "Let's make all your dreams come true! …But for today, let's just have a blast!"
ENFJ>ESFP.do: You plan a get-together to cheer on a friend's big challenge, and on the day you forget all about running it and have the most fun of anyone.
ENFJ>ESFP.worry: You want to protect the fun, but thinking about the future suddenly makes you anxious. You get so caught up in making others happy that what you really feel gets pushed aside.
ENFJ>ESFP.karai: You're passionate about everyone's life plans, but you look the other way when it comes to your own wallet.

ENFP>INTJ.title: You take your overflowing ideas and quietly turn them into detailed plans on your own.
ENFP>INTJ.body: Trusting flashes of insight and possibilities — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the depth you find alone, both a heart that values feelings and a mind that decides by logic, and both the freedom to move on a whim and the steadiness to plan ahead. You don't let an exciting idea stay just a dream — you quietly draw it all the way out into a blueprint.
ENFP>INTJ.say: "This is going to be so fun! …So I made it into a three-step plan."
ENFP>INTJ.do: A hobby you picked up on a whim turns into something you've researched inside and out — complete with a how-to guide you wrote yourself.
ENFP>INTJ.worry: Ideas come in a second, but trying to make the plan perfect means it takes a while to get started. The gap between days you want to hang out with everyone and days you don't want anyone around can confuse the people close to you.
ENFP>INTJ.karai: Five seconds after a great idea hits, you've already counted three flaws in it.

ENFP>INTP.title: You deepen your sparks of insight through curiosity about people and a love of logic.
ENFP>INTP.body: Trusting your hunches and adapting flexibly as things change — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the depth you find in solo thinking, and both a heart that values feelings and a mind that follows logic. Whatever catches your interest, you can blow it up with friends in a burst of excitement or dig alone into how it works deep down — you're curiosity in human form.
ENFP>INTP.say: "Hey, isn't this interesting? …Wait, hang on — let me think about why it's interesting."
ENFP>INTP.do: A question that pops up while talking with a friend has you researching alone until the middle of the night.
ENFP>INTP.worry: Your interests keep jumping, so it's hard to feel you've ever finished anything. After saying what's logically right, you worry you may have left the other person's feelings behind.
ENFP>INTP.karai: You've opened so many search tabs that you've forgotten what you wanted to know in the first place.

ENFP>ENTJ.title: You pull exciting dreams into reality without hesitation.
ENFP>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people and trusting your intuition — that's the same in your temperament and your character. Beyond that, you have both a heart that values feelings and a mind that decides by logic, and both the ease to adapt on the spot and the drive to plan your way forward. You talk about dreams that get everyone excited, then turn them straight into goals and steps and lead the way — a leader who brings both fun and results.
ENFP>ENTJ.say: "This would be so much fun if we all did it! …So, deadline's the end of next month. Let's assign roles."
ENFP>ENTJ.do: An idea that took off over drinks with friends is a proposal and schedule in everyone's inbox by the next morning.
ENFP>ENTJ.worry: The harder you push for results, the fewer happy faces you seem to see, and that gets you down. You're pulled between sticking to the plan and taking a more interesting detour.
ENFP>ENTJ.karai: You keep saying "let's just have fun," yet you're the one chasing the numbers hardest.

ENFP>ENTP.title: You polish your ideas with both heart and logic.
ENFP>ENTP.body: How fast you spot something interesting — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the ability to sense people's feelings and the ability to reason things through. You don't just come up with ideas — you can ask yourself both "Who will this make happy?" and "Will this actually work?"
ENFP>ENTP.say: "That's fun! …But wait, there might be a hole in it."
ENFP>ENTP.do: Halfway through giving a friend advice, you're suddenly offering three ways to improve things.
ENFP>ENTP.worry: After winning an argument, you picture the other person's face and feel down. Every time, you're torn over whether to lead with being right or being kind.
ENFP>ENTP.karai: After you win the argument, the one who takes the most damage is usually you.

ENFP>INFJ.title: You grow your caring insights into a quiet, steady belief.
ENFP>INFJ.body: Picturing possibilities and deciding with care for people's feelings — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the ability to settle your heart alone, and both the freedom to follow your whims and the steadiness to plan ahead. You open up to anyone in no time, and deep down you've been nurturing a wish to help others as a goal that doesn't waver.
ENFP>INFJ.say: "Wow, that's lovely! …Hey, what does it mean to you?"
ENFP>INFJ.do: In the middle of a fun chat, you remember something the other person let slip, and a few days later you quietly check on them.
ENFP>INFJ.worry: You want to act on your ideas right away, but you stop to ask, "Is this really right?" You love being with people, but when you get too involved, you need time alone afterward.
ENFP>INFJ.karai: You can make friends with anyone, but your heart's door has a triple lock.

ENFP>INFP.title: You can nurture what moves your heart, out loud or in quiet.
ENFP>INFP.body: Trusting your intuition, valuing feelings, and moving freely where your heart leads — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the depth you find in time alone. You can dream big with friends or pour your feelings into a journal or something you make alone, so you're really good at getting what you feel across to others.
ENFP>INFP.say: "Hey, hey, listen! …Oh wait, I can't put it into words yet — can I write it down first?"
ENFP>INFP.do: Heading home after a big group hangout, you put in your earbuds and jot down the day's best moments.
ENFP>INFP.worry: Your wish to see people and your wish to be alone rise and fall in big waves, so sometimes a plan starts to feel heavy right after you make it. You love so many things, yet you move on to the next before any of them take shape.
ENFP>INFP.karai: When someone invites you, you say "I'm in!" right away — then regret it alone the night before.

ENFP>ENFJ.title: You spread your excitement to others and turn it into everyone's strength.
ENFP>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people, trusting your intuition, and deciding with your heart — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the freedom to move as things unfold and the drive to plan and follow through. You share a fun idea, get people on board, and then take responsibility for pulling it all together, so before you know it you're at the center of the circle.
ENFP>ENFJ.say: "If we all do this, it'll be so much fun! …Okay, I'll be the one to organize it."
ENFP>ENFJ.do: A surprise you thought of on a whim happens that very day, after you've lined up everyone's schedules.
ENFP>ENFJ.worry: The more you're given the lead, the less time you have to act on a whim. You care so much about doing your part that even on off days you force a smile.
ENFP>ENFJ.karai: You say you want to live free, but you're always the one running the group calendar.

ENFP>ENFP.title: You've let your gift for finding joy grow freely.
ENFP>ENFP.body: The temperament you were born with and the character you've grown through experience are the same type. Your excitement for new things, your belief in people's potential, and your way of widening your world wherever your heart leads have grown steadily without wavering. Because your sense of self is so clear, you shine brighter than anyone where you're free to move — and in places full of rules and routine, your energy tends to fade without you knowing why.
ENFP>ENFP.say: "Wait, what's that? Sounds fun — let's go!"
ENFP>ENFP.do: You get off at a station you've never been to, make friends with someone at a shop you happen to walk into, and come home with their number.
ENFP>ENFP.worry: You love starting things, but you tend to blame yourself for getting bored before you finish. You may seem lively, but sometimes a passing comment hurts you deeply.
ENFP>ENFP.karai: A hundred things on your bucket list. Three checked off.

ENFP>ISTJ.title: You bring a free-spirited spark to a steady, reliable everyday life.
ENFP>ISTJ.body: You do what's decided with precision and keep your promises — a sincere, dependable person. You also have a curiosity that gets excited about new possibilities and loves having fun with others. So even in your usual work, a little playfulness or a fresh twist shows through. You're so proper, yet surprisingly fun to talk to.
ENFP>ISTJ.say: "Let's follow the steps. …Oh, by the way, I came up with something really fun lately."
ENFP>ISTJ.do: You take the same route to work every day, but on days off you head out on a whim to towns you've never seen.
ENFP>ISTJ.worry: You get everything done properly, but when every day feels the same, something starts to feel missing. You want to try out your ideas, but "What if it fails?" makes you overly careful.
ENFP>ISTJ.karai: Taking meeting notes with a serious face — and three new project ideas in the margins.

ENFP>ISFJ.title: You bring your bright ideas to people with careful, thoughtful attention.
ENFP>ISFJ.body: Deciding with care for people's feelings — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the calm you find alone, both an eye for new possibilities and a careful habit of checking the facts in front of you, and both the freedom to move lightly and the loyalty to keep what you've decided. Even when a fun idea hits, you check "Is everyone okay with this?" before you move — that's how kind you are.
ENFP>ISFJ.say: "Hey, want to have a picnic sometime? …I already looked up a backup spot in case it rains."
ENFP>ISFJ.do: You're tempted to pick a bold gift for a friend, but in the end you carefully choose something they'll really use.
ENFP>ISFJ.worry: Part of you wants to jump into something new, but worrying about causing others trouble keeps you from taking the first step. When people ask for help you say yes, and your own fun gets pushed back.
ENFP>ISFJ.karai: You say "I want an adventure for once" — while ordering your usual at your usual place.

ENFP>ESTJ.title: You keep things running smoothly with a brightness that pulls people in.
ENFP>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the imagination to picture possibilities and the drive to act on facts, both a heart that values feelings and a mind that decides by logic, and both the freedom to move lightly and the steadiness to stick to the plan. You set the steps and lead everyone, while slipping in bits of playfulness to brighten the room — a fun kind of organizer.
ENFP>ESTJ.say: "We meet at nine — no one's late, please! …And for lunch, let's all go try somewhere new."
ENFP>ESTJ.do: You lay out exactly how the work will go, then sneak a little quiz into every weekly team meeting.
ENFP>ESTJ.worry: The more responsibility you're given, the more you feel you're forgetting the fun of acting on a whim. After pointing out a rule, you can't stop worrying whether the other person is feeling down.
ENFP>ESTJ.karai: Five minutes after saying "let's play it by ear," you're handing out a step-by-step guide.

ENFP>ESFJ.title: With a heart full of excitement, you warmly support everyone's everyday life.
ENFP>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with care for feelings — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both a feel that's moved by new possibilities and a steady respect for familiar ways and experience, and both the freedom to move lightly and the loyalty to keep what you've decided. You come up with new plans everyone can enjoy, and on the day you look after every detail so no one is left stuck — the host everyone can count on.
ENFP>ESFJ.say: "Let's do something a little different for this year's holiday party! …Oh, and of course I'll handle the seating and food."
ENFP>ESFJ.do: At a class get-together you suggest a new game, and afterward you send photos and updates to the friends who couldn't make it.
ENFP>ESFJ.worry: You want everyone to be happy so much that if a new idea gets a lukewarm response, you pull it right back. Wanting adventure and wanting to protect your usual comfort both matter, and you're torn.
ENFP>ESFJ.karai: You planned a surprise, then got so nervous you checked with the guest of honor first.

ENFP>ISTP.title: You pair a spark of inspiration with the cool focus to work things out with your hands.
ENFP>ISTP.body: Adapting flexibly to whatever's happening — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the energy you get from people and the focus you find alone, both a feel for possibilities and an eye for the facts in front of you, and both a heart that values feelings and a mind that judges by logic. You try out ideas right away, and if they don't work, you calmly find the cause and fix it — like a nimble experimenter.
ENFP>ISTP.say: "Wouldn't it be cool if we did it like this? …Eh, we'll find out if we try."
ENFP>ISTP.do: You find a fun gadget online and take it apart to see how it works before ever reading the manual.
ENFP>ISTP.worry: Your wish to have fun with people and your wish to work quietly alone come in big waves, and you worry people will think you're antisocial. Showing how you feel through actions is easier than saying it, so you're often misunderstood.
ENFP>ISTP.karai: You truly feel for people's problems — yet all that comes out of your mouth is solutions.

ENFP>ISFP.title: You can share what moves you, both with others and with yourself.
ENFP>ISFP.body: Valuing feelings and moving freely where your heart leads — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the energy you get from people and the fullness you find in time alone, and both an imagination for what hasn't happened yet and a sense that savors the colors, sounds, and textures right in front of you. Laughing together in a lively crowd or quietly making something you love on your own — you truly enjoy both.
ENFP>ISFP.say: "Hey, look at this view! …Actually, let's not say anything. I just want to look for a while."
ENFP>ISFP.do: On a fun trip with friends, you slip away for a moment on your own to take a photo of flowers by the road.
ENFP>ISFP.worry: Wanting to connect with people and wanting to keep your own pace are both strong, so every time you turn down an invite you feel a little low. You love so many things, but when someone asks about your future goals, you're stuck for an answer.
ENFP>ISFP.karai: Everyone's smiling in your group photos, but most of your camera roll is sky and cats.

ENFP>ESTP.title: With ideas and drive, you're off the moment inspiration strikes.
ENFP>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people and adapting flexibly in the moment — that's your core, in both temperament and character. Beyond that, you have both the imagination to picture possibilities and a feel for grabbing what's real right now, and both a heart that values feelings and the clarity to make clean, logical calls. You dive into anything that looks fun before anyone else and can size up the pros and cons on the spot, so people see you as "the one who always makes something happen."
ENFP>ESTP.say: "Wait, we could go right now! …Though that place is pricey — let's try somewhere else."
ENFP>ESTP.do: The moment you hear a friend has no weekend plans, you've invited them and booked train tickets for a day trip.
ENFP>ESTP.worry: After deciding on impulse, you worry you may have left someone's feelings behind. While you chase the fun, your prep for what's ahead always ends up last-minute.
ENFP>ESTP.karai: On days you go out "just for a bit," you usually end up catching the last train home.

ENFP>ESFP.title: With an excited heart, you enjoy this very moment to the fullest.
ENFP>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people, valuing feelings, and adapting flexibly in the moment — that's your core, in both temperament and character. On top of that, you have both the imagination to picture what hasn't happened yet and a sense that soaks up the fun right in front of you. You make people laugh with big, dreamy talk while fully enjoying today's food and scenery, so the days of those around you get a little brighter.
ENFP>ESFP.say: "Let's travel around the world someday! …For now, let's go get those crepes!"
ENFP>ESFP.do: Heading home after a big talk about the future, you get pulled straight into a festival you happen to spot.
ENFP>ESFP.worry: There are so many fun things that before you know it, you're short on both money and time. Because you seem so lively, people don't notice when you're feeling down.
ENFP>ESFP.karai: Your dreams for the future are huge — but tomorrow's breakfast is still undecided.
